description: For every coded binary tree \(T\), supplied decider \(t\), and stage \(e\), the specified rule either takes its least possible divergence restriction and forces \(\Phi_e^A(x_e)\) to diverge on all next-stage paths, or retains the same tree and supplies one computable output bound from \(q(t_e,e)\), where \(t_e\) is the specified finite-stage decider compiled from \(t,L_e\), for all old-stage paths. The branch agrees exactly with whether a divergence extension is possible.
